subject: A free "Your Brain vs AI" session for SASTRA students
body:
Dear Dean, SWAS,

I read that the Vice President launched SASTRA.AI in August as part of six new initiatives, and that SWAS works on counselling, stress management, mindfulness and study skills. Those two things meet in the question I work on.

Students now have AI tools that can write, summarise and answer in seconds. What most programmes do not teach is how to keep their own attention, memory and judgement strong while using them. I run UnAI Labs, where I teach four short, science-backed courses on exactly this: AI literacy, neuroplasticity, deep focus and brain health.

I would like to offer SASTRA a free 45-minute guest lecture, "Your Brain vs AI", for any batch you choose, online or on campus. It is plain-language, based on published research, and leaves students with three habits they can use the same week. It would sit naturally alongside SWAS's emotional and academic wellness work.

Would a slot in November or December work for your calendar?

Warm regards,
Manish Kumar Singh
Founder, UnAI Labs
unai-labs.com

If you would rather not hear from me again, reply "no thanks" and I will not write again.
